paragraphs.source_en: Chief Tachibana and Kindaichi were already acquainted, for, as the reader knows, our detective was questioned by the Nasu police after Toyoichiro Wakabayashi was murdered. Chief Tachibana had subsequently made inquiries to the Tokyo police regarding Kindaichi's background and must have received answers exceedingly flattering to the private investigator, for ever since then, though still half in doubt, he had regarded this inconsequential-looking, stuttering man of smallish build and uncombed hair with curiosity and a certain awe.
